scene: The beacon unlocks the gallery terrace where three night rides wait outside.
picture: Flat side view on a street terrace outside the gallery. The player in a teal bomber jacket, dark jeans, and messenger bag stands left-of-centre. On the far left waits a purple night bus at a sign. At centre waits a bicycle rickshaw. On the far right waits a boxy yellow electric milk float.
shown: A purple double-decker night bus idling at a stop sign on the far left
A canopy bicycle rickshaw with a friendly driver seated at the centre
A small electric milk float loaded with clinking glass bottles on the far right
